plan.failureSummary: The chat backend API (`/api/chat`) returns HTTP 500 Internal Server Error when submitting messages, preventing the chatbot from replying.
observedIndicators: Browser logs show POST requests to `https://briefcase.chat/api/chat` failed with status 500 Internal Server Error (x3).
The failure screenshot and page analysis confirm the user message ('What is a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)...') was posted into the UI, but no assistant response was ever rendered.
The page.ai agent marked the objective as not completable due to backend LLM responses failing/returning empty.

remediationSteps.details: Investigate and resolve the 500 Internal Server Error on the `https://briefcase.chat/api/chat` backend route (check LLM API keys, upstream provider connectivity, or backend handler exceptions).
Re-run the conversational bot compliance test suite once the backend chat endpoint is operational.

additionalDataRequests.description: Server-side logs for the /api/chat endpoint on briefcase.chat to diagnose why the backend is returning HTTP 500 on message submission.

plan.notes: The autonomous evaluator accurately flagged that no responses were generated by the bot. Network logs confirm 3 consecutive HTTP 500 errors on POST https://briefcase.chat/api/chat.
